# Version 4.154.0
> **Skia m154 and docs** · [NuGet (prerelease)](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.154.0-preview.1.26454.9)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.154.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1.400/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.154.0 previews the Skia m154 engine update and compiler-generated XML API documentation. HarfBuzzSharp bindings now follow the bundled native source, including a corrected Unicode combining-class enum name.

## Breaking Changes

- **UnicodeCombiningClass.CCC133 renamed to CCC132** — The corrected upstream HarfBuzz name is now CCC132 while its numeric value remains 132. Update source references from CCC133 to CCC132 before upgrading.
- **GlyphFlags.Defined is no longer exposed** — The aggregate Defined mask is removed because it does not represent an independent option. Combine the concrete GlyphFlags values required by your application instead.

## Engine

- **Skia updated through milestone m154** — The bundled renderer advances to m154 and includes the latest upstream bug and buffer-upload fixes. ([#4945](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4945), [#5054](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5054), [#5114](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5114))

## API Surface

- **API documentation ships as compiler XML** — NuGet packages now include compiler-generated XML documentation sidecars, keeping API reference text adjacent to the managed assemblies. ([#5053](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5053), [#5064](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5064), [#5066](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5066), [#5078](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5078), [#5080](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5080), [#5091](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5091))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1.400

HarfBuzzSharp bindings are generated from the DEPS-pinned native source and include corrected enum coverage while continuing to exclude unsupported callback-heavy APIs.
